research_question: Does ego-intent-conditioned particle future representation improve planning beyond generic register or video patch features under controlled training and planning conditions?

current_evidence.current_baselines: Modified small-corpus backbones connected to a common DrivoR planner; not the full original papers.

representation_comparison.planner: Same generator/scorer architecture, initial planner tensors, loss, proposal budget, ego status and candidate selection rule; train each planner with its own backbone.
representation_comparison.planning_training: Same scene tokens, recording split, effective batch, scene exposures, update budget, planner LR schedule and paired seeds.
representation_comparison.inputs: Same cameras, observed timestamps, original RGB coverage, resolution and augmentation. Retain appropriate native backbone normalization and document patch padding.
representation_comparison.memory: Same token count and embedding width; report internal particle count, active trainable parameters and actual compute.
representation_comparison.adaptation: Backbone-specific LR may be selected on development data with equal tuning budget; equal LoRA rank does not match parameter count.
representation_comparison.ssl: Audit external initialization, local SSL clips, frames and exposures; match local driving corpus when testing pretraining method, or ablate and report remaining pretraining differences.
representation_comparison.remaining_limitation: Different native backbones and external pretraining remain confounds for a particle-only claim. A stronger mechanism comparison needs common visual features with register versus particle construction.
representation_comparison.encoder_intent: Match encoder access to the command across backbones, or separately ablate encoder command conditioning in each backbone; the same planner ego status alone does not isolate particle structure from early command injection.

complete_system_comparison.baselines: Official full DrivoR and Drive-JEPA agents/checkpoints, including their canonical input and planning logic, evaluated through the same official evaluator version.
complete_system_comparison.training: Choose and report one official benchmark training recipe, labels and external pretraining; do not label the present 75297 internal training scenes as full official training.
complete_system_comparison.v1: Full NAVTEST PDMS after protocol and checkpoint selection rule are fixed.
complete_system_comparison.v2: Optional NAVHARD EPDMS with matching official v2 evaluator, cache, two-stage rollout and supervision; never compare PDMS to EPDMS.
complete_system_comparison.original_jepa_logic: Multimodal trajectory distillation and momentum-aware selection are part of the complete Drive-JEPA method and absent from our common-planner JEPA baseline.

first_development_diagnosis.inputs: Saved checkpoints and a fixed development panel; GT and oracle labels used only for diagnosis.
first_development_diagnosis.interpretation: Low oracle-best candidate quality localizes the limitation to candidate generation or its inputs; a large oracle-to-selected gap localizes it to candidate scoring/selection. Neither alone identifies Stage1 as the cause.
first_development_diagnosis.planner_modification_policy: If safety losses or refinement are introduced in a representation comparison, apply the same planner modification to every backbone condition.
first_development_diagnosis.initial_panel: Use 128-256 fixed development scenes selected without model scores for an initial diagnosis, then expand a confirmed finding.

minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.difference: Freeze only LPWM LoRA at initialization; train the same encoder command FiLM, projection and planner as the complete condition.
minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.question: Incremental effect of updating native-world-model paths through LoRA; distinguish this from fully frozen LPWM plus frozen FiLM.

minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.difference: Train from the common initialization using repeated current attributes in the same eight future positions and unchanged planner interface.
minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.question: Benefit of forecast information beyond observed-history features; report active parameter/compute differences and optionally use a capacity-matched learned expansion control.

minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.difference: Remove command conditioning only from particle generation while retaining the identical command in the planner ego status.
minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.question: Benefit of conditioning representation on intent beyond feeding intent to the planner.

minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.difference: Current proposed complete LPWM method: native Stage1 initialization, intent conditioning, predicted future particles and planning-path LoRA.
minimal_lpwm_ablation_conditions.question: Combined contribution; other conditions start from the same Stage1 and initial planner, with matched training.

representation_diagnostics: GT object state and future displacement probes on recording-disjoint fit/evaluation splits; labels are for evaluation and do not become training losses by default.
Planning-relevant particle intervention compared with random removal matched on particle number, presence, feature norm and spatial extent; assess finite-distribution and perturbation effects.
Inference-only future repetition/time shuffle complements separately trained ablations; it is not sufficient causal evidence by itself.

Changing encoder command for the same image tests sensitivity. Alternative-command correctness requires consistent routes/simulation or alternative valid targets, not the original single-command GT trajectory.
Movement toward visible objects is supplementary visualization, not an attention map or proof of preserved task information.

evaluation_policy.development: Use a fixed recording-disjoint development split for design and checkpoint choice; audit both Stage1 and Stage2 leakage.
evaluation_policy.navtest_history: The existing 1024-scene panel has already been observed; report this history. Fix further choices before final official evaluation and use an untouched recording-disjoint confirmation panel when making independent confirmation claims.
evaluation_policy.seeds: One paired seed for initial screening, then at least three paired seeds for a main result; report per-seed values and training variability separately from recording-level sampling uncertainty.
evaluation_policy.primary_metric: Predefine a meaningful PDMS improvement threshold and safety noninferiority margins; do not choose them after test scores.
evaluation_policy.confidence: Paired recording-cluster intervals for each baseline; a positive superiority interval is evidence within this protocol, not universal model superiority or proof of the mechanism.
evaluation_policy.scenario_metrics: Prespecify turn, vehicle density, pedestrian and occlusion strata from data annotations or declared proxies; do not define hard scenes using a baseline score.
evaluation_policy.efficiency: Report Stage1 and Stage2 cost, inference latency/FPS, model peak VRAM and parameter count; token equality alone does not match compute.

recommended_order: Inspect development candidate quality and ranking gap.
Preserve current fixed 25-epoch run and inspect its next development checkpoints.
Register fresh common-input/common-training DrivoR and JEPA controls, initially on one seed; a 128x128 comparison supports the low-resolution protocol only.
Run LoRA, future and encoder-intent ablations under the same protocol.
Repeat promising main comparisons with paired seeds, then evaluate final agents with the fixed official full benchmark protocol.
